name: self-improve
description: Find the corrections you keep repeating to Claude Code and turn them into reviewed changes to your skills, CLAUDE.md and memory.

plugins.name: self-improve
plugins.description: A self-improvement loop for Claude Code: finds where you corrected Claude more than once, sorts each fix into apply-now / needs-your-OK / needs-an-answer, lets you decide with buttons, and applies only what you approved.
